text:
[RFCS.5.4] A reader must treat a `FactAssert` atom for an unrecognised
`schema_name` as a fatal stream error. A `schema_name` is unrecognised in two
cases:

- no `SchemaDef` for it has reached the reader's descriptor pool ([RFCS.5.3]);
- the reader is a runtime replaying the stream, and its engine holds no schema of
  that name: neither the artefact it loaded nor the built-in module declares one
  ([NFCT.1.1]).

A runtime replaying the stream must stop at that atom and return
`DS_ERR_SCHEMA_UNKNOWN` in either case, and the same code whether it meets the
atom as it opens the stream or partway through the replay. A reader with no engine, decoding a stream offline, meets only the
first case.
